links.comparator_used: Baseline LLM classification without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Accuracy of contraindication classification (no contraindication, relative, absolute) across three LLMs; weighted kappa; relative contraindication detection
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 85.8%-87.1% at baseline to 92.5%-98.4% with RAG (all p < 0.05). Weighted kappa rose from 0.885-0.913 to 0.949-0.990. Relative contraindication detection rose from 42.1%-56.1% to 59.6%-93.0%. Absolute contraindication safety catch rates stayed at 99.0%-100.0% in all conditions.
links.quote: Baseline accuracy ranged from 85.8% to 87.1% across models and improved to 92.5% to 98.4% with RAG (all p < 0.05).
